blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Faith Nisperos’ comeback served as a silver lining for Akari despite missing the semifinals of the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. The fit-again Nisperos gave her all in their final game of the first of the All-Filipino series with 15 points, seven digs, and seven excellent receptions, only for Akari to absorb a 25-22, 22-25, 25-18, 25-21 loss to ZUS Coffee on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. “We had a really long talk because today was our last game of the series.
